messages:
elaine: Quick sync on marketplace telemetry readiness — goal: finalize what goes in the Datadog tile + partner checklist for private deployments next week. Need owners for screenshot capture, legal blurb, and embargo timing.

vijay: I can own partner coordination. We should lock the feature list first: traces with gpu tags, agent DaemonSet snippet, and a short architecture diagram.

mike: I'll own the DaemonSet + snippet. We should also include a small troubleshooting section: common egress blocks, service-mapping tips, and sampling settings.

sam: I'll prepare a short demo repo with manifest, sample app, and a script to populate gpu_model/gpu_uuid node labels. Keep it to one kubectl apply and one curl smoke test.

kevin (dd): From Datadog side we need an importable dashboard JSON and a tile screenshot 1200x600. Also prefer using agent relay in Private flows and recommend setting sampling.rate to 0.1 for demo scale. I can supply a starter dashboard.

neontech-eng: We'll review the demo and try it in our air-gapped staging. Ask: can the demo run without a real API key? We prefer token-exchange or local agent relay.

accelops-pm: We'll help capture marketplace screenshots and list the telemetry prerequisites in marketplace tile copy. Also can help test the DaemonSet in our lab.

legal-biz: Heads up: any joint announcement after the sandbox needs a one-week review for partner mentions. If you plan press, route drafts to us and marketing.

marketing: Noted. If partners approve, we can do a short technical blog + 2-sentence partner callout. Need final screenshots and a short technical quote.

elaine: Proposal: Day 0: run sandbox with partners. Day 1: collect screenshots + draft marketplace tile copy. Day 2: internal review (legal + marketing). Final post on Day 5. Is that timeline ok?

vijay: Works for partners. I'll ask NeonTech/AccelOps for SOC clearance timelines and confirm.

mike: Tech note: for GPU metadata we recommend node labels: gpu.redwood/model and gpu.redwood/uuid, and an init script that exports DD_TAGS="gpu_model:$GPU_MODEL,gpu_uuid:$GPU_UUID". Add to docs.

sam: Repo will include make targets: make demo-deploy, make smoke-trace, make capture-screenshots. Also a small script to sanitize screenshots (no tokens, no internal IPs).

kevin (dd): Dashboard snippet for import (inline): {"title":"marketplace-inference-tiles","widgets":[{"type":"timeseries","title":"p95 latency by gpu","query":"p95:trace.duration{service:inference} by {gpu_model}"},{"type":"query_value","title":"requests/s","query":"sum:trace.hits{service:inference}.rollup(sum,60)"}]} — I'll post full JSON to the shared drive.

legal-biz: Reminder: screenshots must not include customer-identifying data. Use synthetic traces and fake UUIDs in demo.

marketing: I'll draft the marketplace copy: 1 short elevator line, 3 bullets (what's included, quickstart, links). Need the screenshot and a 50-word partner quote by Tue EOD.

elaine: Action items:
- sam: demo repo + manifests + screenshot tool by Mon EOD
- mike: DaemonSet snippet + troubleshooting doc by Mon EOD
- kevin (dd): dashboard JSON + sample screenshot by Mon EOD
- vijay: partner SOC + approval timeline by Mon EOD
- marketing/legal: slot for review, please confirm turnaround by Tue noon

calendar-bot: elaine scheduled "Marketplace telemetry prep: screenshots + legal review" Tue 10:00-11:00 PT invite sent.

accelops-pm: We'll run through the demo on Mon and provide feedback.

neontech-eng: Thanks — we'll scrub the lab and use synthetic traces. We'll also test the agent-in-relay mode and report back.

elaine: Thanks team. If partners sign off we can enable the tile next week. I'll post links to the shared drive when Kevin uploads the dashboard.
